intro.title: Bridging Digital Division for Village Infrastructure
intro.description: Smart Village Management System brings modern civic-tech directly to rural panchayats. Citizen complaints are logged transparently, auto-assigned to responsible village workers, and tracked step-by-step in real time.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: 5 Simple steps from problem reporting to verified resolution
howItWorks.step1Desc: Citizen submits problem with photo, location & details.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Gram Panchayat admin reviews & sets priority.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Worker executes repair & uploads resolution photo.
howItWorks.step5Desc: Admin verifies & complaint is closed with instant citizen alert.
